name: Algolia
whyPeoplePay: Algolia sells search that feels instant on someone else's infrastructure: typo tolerance, ranking rules, analytics and a dashboard your PM can open, billed on records and search operations so the invoice grows with success.

plans.name: Build
plans.note: Free tier with usage caps; overage and higher tiers are usage-priced.

plans.name: Grow
plans.note: Usage-based; no honest flat monthly number without a traffic assumption.

pricing.note: Algolia is usage-priced on records and search operations. We do not invent a bill from operations you have not counted. Re-read the pricing page with your record and search volume before comparing.

ranked.rationale: A self-hosted search engine API with typo tolerance and a simple HTTP interface. You run the binary, hold the master key, create a search-scoped API key for browsers, and keep the indexes on disk you control. License at the pin is MIT AND BUSL-1.1 with EE features under BUSL.

evaluatedNotTested.name: Typesense
evaluatedNotTested.note: The closest Algolia-shaped rival: typo-tolerant instant search with an API-key model. GPL-3.0 (a copyleft server some teams need to clear with legal), 26k stars, actively developed with official versioned typesense/typesense images. Meilisearch keeps the top spot here for the permissive-core licence and lighter single-binary operational story, not on capability.

evaluatedNotTested.name: Sonic
evaluatedNotTested.note: MPL-2.0, 21k stars, active, with versioned valeriansaliou/sonic images (v1.7 line). A search backend rather than a search product: it returns matching IDs from a normalized index and leaves relevance, typo-tolerance and ranking to your application, so it answers a lighter question than Algolia does.

evaluatedNotTested.name: ZincSearch
evaluatedNotTested.note: Apache-2.0 in the repository's LICENSE even though GitHub's API reports NOASSERTION. Elasticsearch-shaped API rather than Algolia-shaped, and the maintainers' energy has visibly moved to their OpenObserve product; pushes had slowed to a stop by mid-2026. Surveyed for completeness, not a live contender.
